trigger.description: A current request searches the complete admitted user-global memory snapshot through an in-memory Frankensearch lexical index when the global index is genuinely missing or has clean source-generation lag, independently of workspace index readiness. The source corpus must fit the 4096-document and 16-MiB bounds. Explicit historical reads, incompatible or corrupt assets, retained-generation ambiguity, and redirected paths do not acquire fallback authority. Read-only retrieval does not consume global index jobs or publish an index. This global-only advisory cannot certify a complete workspace snapshot for cached pack reuse.
setup_commands: # In an isolated store, publish the workspace index and create an admitted global memory without publishing its global index.
